incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: inference-prod-eu — high_tail_latency (p99 = 1800ms, threshold 1500ms). Alert ID: <https://pd.example/alerts/12345|ALERT-12345>. Auto-page to oncall.
maya: acked. I'm taking primary.
omar: on call — standing by to help. any obvious regional changes?
maya: quick check — tokenizers in eu cluster showing bursty latency + KV evictions. redis latency spiked ~40% around the same time.
ryan: seeing elevated req queue on tokenizer pods (tok-svc-eu-*) and a few restarts in the last 10m.
maya: starting quick mitigation: rolling restart of tokenizer-eu to recycle jvm/heap and clear sticky caches. running:
```
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deployment/tokenizer-eu
```
omar: attempting to increase autoscaler min to reduce cold-starts: HPA tokenizer-eu min=3 -> 5.
omar: applied. watching scale events.
incident-bot: auto-suppress attempted but failed: suppression window conflict (recent suppression at 1932104000). Manual ack required.
maya: noted. manual suppression skipped — want to keep alerts until we verify p99 drop.
ryan: can we route small fraction to fallback model / model-variant-small to reduce tail?
maya: switching 10% traffic to fallback via routing policy now.
nikki: FYI CS already flagged a couple Dedicated customers seeing slow responses. I've opened ticket INC-9876 and pinged account reps.
omar: warming KV cache by replaying hot prefixes (script started, ~5k keys warmed).
maya: p99 trending down — 1.6s -> 1.35s over last 2 mins. continuing to monitor.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: alert acknowledged by maya.
maya: keeping oncall until stable for 20m. will handoff to omar if stable earlier. :thumbsup:
ryan: logs show a particular request type spiked CPU on tokenizers (long-context batch). adding a guard to reject oversized batch for now. patch applied.
maya: p99 now 1.2s, p95 400ms. marking as mitigated and will let PD auto-resolve if it stays under threshold.
incident-bot: Alert status: resolved (p99 < 1500ms). Closing in 5m unless reopened.
nikki: notes for follow-up: possible root causes = bursty long-context batch + cache churn + redis tail. Customer impact: ~12 Dedicated customers experienced 5-15% latency degradation during window. I'll draft post-incident summary and ops checklist.
maya: thanks all. please add deployment + HPA diffs to INC-9876. omar — if it reappears please take over.
omar: copied. handing off monitoring.
pagerduty: Pager closed by incident-bot (ALERT-12345).
__notes: autogenerated slack thread about an oncall latency alert, includes incident-bot/PagerDuty messages, short replies and mitigation steps
